<script>
(function () {
  var container = document.getElementById('gbPanels');
  if (!container) return;
  var panels = container.querySelectorAll('.gb-panel');

  panels.forEach(function (panel) {
    panel.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var isExpanded = panel.classList.contains('is-expanded');
      panels.forEach(function (p) {
        p.classList.remove('is-expanded');
        p.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
      if (!isExpanded) {
        panel.classList.add('is-expanded');
        panel.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        container.classList.add('has-expanded');
      } else {
        container.classList.remove('has-expanded');
      }
    });

    panel.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        panel.click();
      }
    });
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var stack = document.getElementById('gbLayerStack');
  if (!stack) return;
  var cards = Array.from(stack.querySelectorAll('.gb-layer-card'));
  var dots  = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#gbLayerDots .gb-layer-dot'));
  var total = cards.length;
  var current = 0;
  var states = ['gb-layer-front', 'gb-layer-mid', 'gb-layer-back', 'gb-layer-hidden'];

  function render() {
    cards.forEach(function (card, i) {
      states.forEach(function (s) { card.classList.remove(s); });
      var offset = (i - current + total) % total;
      card.classList.add(states[Math.min(offset, states.length - 1)]);
    });
    dots.forEach(function (dot, i) {
      dot.classList.toggle('active', i === current);
    });
  }

  stack.addEventListener('click', function () {
    current = (current + 1) % total;
    render();
  });

  stack.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
      e.preventDefault();
      current = (current + 1) % total;
      render();
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
      e.preventDefault();
      current = (current - 1 + total) % total;
      render();
    }
  });

  render();
})();
</script>
